The '''attack on ZA-13''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] at the Imperial Facilty known as [[ZA-13]] in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]].

==Prelude==
[[ZA-13]] was, at the time, manufacturing [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] units, made with technology from the [[Habeen]] from [[Mylok IV]], for [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s Imperial forces. These units were originally used for [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], but could also be used for [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. When Zaarin went rogue, he attacked the [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|Omar]] facilities and [[Attack on Omar|destroyed]] them. Then-[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was instructed to capture the facility, as reports were coming in that Zaarin was raiding and destroying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] ability to manufactur the TIE Avengers, with the intention of stripping [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of his stratigic advantage.

The [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]] also wanted to disable the looting vessels to liberate the cargo being looted and find clues to where the bulk of Zaarin's forces were.

==The battle==
The attack was led by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who took 3 [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] starfighters to sweep the area of enemy forces. The factory was fairly lightly defended, firstly by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], which Stele and his wingmen cut through easily. The factory itself remained neutral during the battle, due to the fact that the station's personnel were not all loyal to either Zaarin or the Empire.

Stele also disabled the various freighters and transports that were attempting to make off with the equipment, which were [[Modular conveyor]]s, [[Z-Cod Group|Z-Cod]], which carried [[equipment]], the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Z-Coral]] which was carrying [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Advanced]] parts and the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvettes]] [[Z-Oz Group|Z-Oz]] which had Hyperdrive units. Imperial [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttles]] [[Sigma (Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle)|Sigma]] and [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault ransports]] [[Tiger (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|Tiger]] came in to take possession of the stolen goods, leaving the ships themselves to be finished off by Stele, who was fighting [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] that were coming out of the facility. Soon a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transport]] [[Z-Elpi]] launched out the hanger and tried to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]], only to disabled by Stele, boarded by an Escort shuttle [[Omega 1]] and was sent back into the facility.

==Aftermath==
The Secret order was pleased that the transports, equipment and materials stolen, that was months worth of progress on TIE Advanced production from ZA-13 and that it did not fall into Zaarin's hands.

Stele was soon to return, leading the attack force in the [[Capture of ZA-13]], which would result in the capture of the station itself.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the PC game ''Star Wars TIE Fighter''. This is Battle 8, combat 2. This article assumes all "Primary", "Secondary" and "Bonus" goals are complete.
